name: Bank of America Famers' Market
tagline: FARMERS MARKET @ BANK OF AMERICA PLAZA
description: Bank of America Famers' Market is a farmers market in 333 S. Hope St., CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
